topic: Japanese share of the global silicon wafer market
disagreement: The same ITA guide says Shin-Etsu and SUMCO hold about 90% of the wafer market, but also cites Brookings giving Japan 53%.
possible_reasons: population: unclear whether by revenue, area (MSI) or 300 mm only
the 90% figure has no cited source
rationale: The European Commission lists four large non-Japanese wafer makers (GlobalWafers, Siltronic, SK Siltron, Soitec) after Shin-Etsu and SUMCO, which is hard to reconcile with a 90% two-firm share; the 53% figure has an attributed source.
remaining_uncertainty: No primary firm-level wafer share data was found (see CLM-0569); Brookings original not opened.

topic: Japanese share of global photoresist supply
disagreement: ITA (and USITC citing Japanese media, 2019) put Japanese firms at about 90% of photoresists; ITA citing Brookings (2024) puts Japan at 50%.
possible_reasons: definition: firm-HQ share vs production-location share (Japanese firms produce resist in Korea, Taiwan, US)
population: all resists vs advanced (ArF/EUV) resists
rationale: The figures may count different things (firm nationality vs country of production); no source states its basis.
remaining_uncertainty: Needs a dated research-firm split by supplier and plant location.

disagreement: SEMI first reported 2021 at US$64.3bn (March 2022) and later gave US$66.8bn (June 2023).
possible_reasons: method: SEMI restates prior years as late or revised supplier data arrive ('2021 data reflects current updates')
rationale: Later vintage explicitly flagged as updated.
remaining_uncertainty: Segment-level restatements are not public; growth rates quoted in releases mix vintages.

disagreement: SEMI first reported 2020 at US$55.3bn (March 2021) and later gave US$55.5bn (March 2022).
possible_reasons: method: routine restatement of prior year
remaining_uncertainty: Small (0.4%) revision; latest vintage for 2020 not public.

disagreement: SEMI's public taxonomy lists 9 fab and 8 packaging categories; the MMDS sheet says 10 fab and 6 packaging segments.
possible_reasons: definition: the sheet may split or merge categories differently (e.g. gases into bulk and specialty; mold compounds and encapsulants combined)
rationale: Both are SEMI documents describing different products (taxonomy page vs MMDS deliverable).
remaining_uncertainty: The MMDS segment list itself is behind the paywall.
